name: master-security-toolkit
description: Inspect software, plugins, permissions and AI instruction boundaries, then explain evidence-backed risks and verify targeted fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Review software and agent instruction risks.
interface.longDescription: Inspect software, plugins, permissions and AI instruction boundaries, then explain evidence-backed risks and verify targeted fixes. Review a downloaded package or MCP before admitting it. Scan a local skill/plugin without executing its contents. Review an owned application or prompt boundary and turn demonstrated findings into regression tests. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. A clean static scan is not a safety certificate. Source review, live testing and installation are separate actions. The Atlas is reference material, not a vulnerability scanner.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this artifact or agent workflow for security risks and give me an evidence-backed verdict.
